Capabilities

                          
Technology that delivers
                    
      
    
  
  
    

  

    

  
  

        

    
                                  

Capabilities that drive mission performance
Leidos capabilities are engineered to solve complex challenges with speed, precision, and scale. By combining innovation with proven execution, we enable customers to deploy faster, adapt quickly, and achieve consistent performance in dynamic mission environments.

                    Artificial Intelligence
            
                            

At Leidos, AI is engineered for outcomes and backed by decades of delivery. For more than twenty years, we’ve advanced and applied AI across defense, intelligence, health, and civil sectors. We build and deploy proven AI systems that improve performance, strengthen decision-making, and deliver measurable results.
                                
More on AI
            
      
      

                                      
  

            
              
    
  
  
  

      

      

        
                    Cybersecurity
            
                            

We combine threat insight, applied AI, and real-world operator experience to anticipate and disrupt adversarial activity. We deliver integrated offensive, defensive, and resilience capabilities — supported supported by research and workforce development — to help agencies stay secure and mission-ready.
                                
More on cybersecurity
            
      
      

                                      
  

            
              
    
  
  
  

      

      

        
                    Digital Modernization
            
                            

Leidos delivers digital transformation for government missions with practices spanning resilient network, defensive cyber, secure cloud and data center, application modernization, enterprise digital experience, and information advantage.
                                
More on digital modernization
            
      
      

                                      
  

            
              
    
  
  
  

      

      

        
                    Mission Software
            
                            

Our team builds secure software that connects sensing, data, and decision-making into a clear operational picture. This helps users see what matters, decide faster, and act with confidence.
                                
MORE ON MISSION SOFTWARE
            
      
      

                                      
  

            
              
    
  
  
  

      

      

        
                    Prototyping & Manufacturing
            
                            

With vertically integrated capabilities across electronics, mechanical fabrication, thermal protection, underwater acoustics, system integration, and test, Leidos moves programs from concept to production—quickly, at scale, and ready for mission deployment.
                                
MORE ON MANUFACTURING
            
      
      

                                      
  

            
              
    
  
  
  

      

      

        
                    Quantum
            
                            

Leidos applies quantum science where it counts: precision sensing, secure communications, and navigation in GPS-denied environments. We integrate chip-scale photonic technologies into mission platforms—combining mission expertise, calibration, and data fusion to deliver real operational advantage. 
                                
MORE ON QUANTUM
